summary: eToro Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, furnishing a press release of its Q1 2026 earnings. No special situation is present—this is a routine quarterly earnings report. The excerpt includes financial highlights (e.g., net contribution $258M, net income $82M) and mentions an acquisition of Zengo in passing, but the filing itself does not announce or detail that acquisition; it is merely referenced within the earnings release. No deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic changes are disclosed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report furnishing earnings.
